params.name: sentiment_gte
params.description: Find all articles with entities with a sentiment_score greater than or equal to x. Sentiment is between -1 and +1; 0 = neutral, above 0 = positive, below 0 = negative.

params.name: sentiment_lte
params.description: Find all articles with entities with a sentiment_score less than or equal to x.

params.name: min_match_score
params.description: Find all articles with entities with a match_score greater than or equal to min_match_score.

params.name: filter_entities
params.description: By default all entities for each article are returned; set to true to return only the entities relevant to your query with each article. Default false.

params.name: must_have_entities
params.description: Set to true to ensure that at least one entity has been identified within the article. Default false.

params.name: group_similar
params.description: Group similar articles to avoid displaying multiple articles on the same topic/subject. Default true.

params.name: search
params.description: Full-text search over article body and title. Supports advanced query syntax: + (AND), | (OR), - (negate), quotes (phrase), * (prefix), parentheses (precedence); escape literals with a backslash. Example: "ipo" -nyse
